description.en: Adds a dsh_restart tool so an agent can restart DSH Desktop itself and resume the same conversation: it waits for the current turn to go idle, flushes the session, relaunches the app silently (no confirmation dialog), then injects a continuation prompt into the same session. It refuses to restart while another conversation is running a turn. Silent relaunch is Windows-only.
description.zh: 提供一个 dsh_restart 工具，让 Agent 自己重启 DSH Desktop 并回到同一会话继续：等当前轮结束、落盘会话、静默重启（无确认弹窗），再向同一会话投递续聊指令；其他对话有 turn 在跑时拒绝重启。静默重启仅支持 Windows。
